product.description: „– Ai niște copii tare drăgălași, zise raţa cea bătrână cu pieliţă roșie la picior. Toţi sunt frumușei, în afară de cel cenușiu, care nu-i de soi. Dacă s-ar putea, ar trebui făcut din nou.“   O minunată ediție a celebrei povești scrise de Hans Christian Andersen, ilustrată artistic de ilustratorul belarus contemporan Anton Lomaev.   ANTON LOMAEV a urmat cursurile Academiei Naționale de Artă din Sankt Petersburg și este membru al prestigioasei Uniuni a Artiștilor Ruși. La mijlocul anilor '90 a devenit ilustrator de carte și, de atunci, a ilustrat mai multe basme clasice. A câștigat numeroase premii în Rusia și Ucraina, iar în 2018 a primit Diploma de Onoare din partea IBBY (International Board on Books for Young People).

# The Ugly Duckling by Litera: A Beautifully Illustrated Classic Tale

Immerse your child in the timeless narrative of **The Ugly Duckling**, a beloved fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen. This exquisite edition, published by Litera, brings the story to life not only through classic literature but also through stunning artistic interpretations by renowned illustrator Anton Lomaev. It is an essential addition to any child's library, celebrating themes of self-acceptance and finding one's true place.

## Experience the Story with Masterful Artistry

This special edition does more than just tell a story; it offers a rich, visual experience. The illustrations are provided by Anton Lomaev, a contemporary Belarusian illustrator who brings depth and emotion to every page.

Anton Lomaev is a highly decorated artist, having studied at the National Academy of Art in St. Petersburg. His career has seen him illustrate numerous classic fables, earning multiple awards in Russia and Ukraine. This recognition peaked in 2018 when he received the Diploma of Honor from IBBY (International Board on Books for Young People), solidifying his reputation as a masterful storyteller through art.

The narrative begins with a poignant moment: "â Do you have some very lovely children, said the old rat with red skin on its feet. All are beautiful, except the grayish one, which is not proper. If only he could be made new." This opening sets the stage for a powerful journey of identity and belonging that young readers will connect with deeply.

## Product Details

*   **Brand:** Litera
*   **Category:** Children's Books (Copii)
*   **Price:** 39.99

Discover more about this stunning book and purchase your copy today via the official [Litera Store](https://event.2performant.com/events/click?ad_type=product_store&unique=49c3d36fc&aff_code=bf1d69700&campaign_unique=0a8a2c4d9).

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this a translated version?**
Yes, this edition presents the classic tale by Hans Christian Andersen.

**Who illustrated this specific book?**
The artwork is provided by Anton Lomaev, an award-winning illustrator known for his work on classical fables.

**Does the story teach lessons about self-esteem?**
Absolutely. The themes of uniqueness and finding acceptance are central to *The Ugly Duckling*, making it a valuable read for promoting emotional intelligence in children.
